content.title: About
content.content: Non-dairy milk NFS (203) is a lactose‑free beverage made from a blend of plant‑based ingredients such as oats, rice, or nuts. It has a smooth, creamy taste and is suitable for vegans and people with lactose intolerance. The product is commonly used in coffee, cereals, baking, and as a cow‑milk substitute.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: NFS (203) is formulated with low sugar content, making it diet‑friendly.
The blend includes plant proteins that provide a complete amino‑acid profile.
It is fortified with calcium, vitamin D and B12 to match the nutritional profile of dairy milk.
Plant‑based milk has a lower carbon footprint than animal milk.
NFS (203) undergoes homogenization to prevent separation.

items.title: Rich in vitamins
items.content: Fortified with vitamin D and B12, it supports bone health and the nervous system.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Contains mainly polyunsaturated fats, which are heart‑healthy.

items.title: Digestive friendly
items.content: Absence of lactose makes it safe for people with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: Fortification provides calcium to help maintain strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Plant antioxidants help combat free radicals.

items.title: Allergy to plant ingredients
items.content: The product may contain nuts, soy or oats, which can trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Added sugar content
items.content: Some varieties contain added sugar; choose unsweetened versions if monitoring calorie intake.

items.title: Lower protein compared to cow's milk
items.content: While it provides plant protein, the amount is usually lower than that of dairy milk.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Non-dairy milk NFS (203) can be enjoyed on its own, added to coffee, tea, smoothies, cereals, baked goods, and sauces. It pairs well with fruits, berries, and granola.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 1 °C–4 °C. After opening, consume within 5–7 days. Do not freeze, as texture may change.
